R3_windows.plateau: mean over [b - 300 s, b), b = the end of the hold's last process (launch records), measured and predicted, as rises over the hold's anchor (aifoundry3: 34-sensor mean, last 120 s of the rest before; aifoundry2: the REST file's last 120 s of raw firmware samples)

R3_windows.checkpoint_rule: from the first process's start, 5 s means (one launch cycle on K_S), each that ends before b, plus 'end' = the 5 s (one cycle) ending 0.5 s before b; rms over all

RK3_a.rule: at least 3 of K_S, K_Q, K_L, K_O (K_O = the long hold's first 600 s) have |arm E plateau error| <= critic scale AND arm E checkpoints' rms <= critic scale

RK3_b.rule: G1Q: |arm E plateau error| <= 1.0 C AND arm E checkpoints' rms <= 1.0 C

RK3_c.rule: every hold with a measured plateau rise >= 10 C over its anchor: |arm A plateau error| / measured rise <= 0.015
